findings.name: exotic-source
findings.title: resolved from a git repository instead of PyPI
findings.explanation: poetry.lock resolves pypi:poetry-core@2.4.1 from a git repository (https://github.com/python-poetry/poetry-core.git#b9663e42c808543377ae523611c4cfad68016f30) rather than from PyPI. None of the registry's protections apply to it: the release cannot be yanked, advisories are not matched against it, and there is no publisher, provenance or download history to compare with the previous version. The version number the lockfile records is what the fetched manifest claimed, not a version anyone published. The revision b9663e42c808543377ae523611c4cfad68016f30 is a full commit sha, so at least the content is pinned.
